_doc: TANG 1 — cau khung cua GHI CHU HE THONG dua cho agent cap 2 (chep tu Sales Desk server.js 16131–16248). Moi khoi mot mau; cho trong {…} do ma dien tu su that cua luot. Thu tu `order` la thu tu Desk that su ghep (VAN_DON dat dau vi ghi chu bi cat 4000 ky tu tu cuoi). Loi dinh nganh (size, tra_kho, mon the thao) nam o nganh/<id>/ghi-chu-he-thong.json va GHI DE tung khoa o day; nganh khong co tep thi dung loi chung. 05/10/2026 (phieu Desk 'khach da co don bot ban lai'): don GAN CHAC voi hoi thoai (landing tinh giai doan tu trang thai don + van don + han don treo shop khai). Khoi nay dat DAU ghi chu cho LLM#1, agent, LLM#3; khong nam trong `order` (ma dung rieng). {danhSach} = cac dong DON_DANG_CHAY.dong.

blocks.VAN_DON: VAN DON CUA KHACH — don {maDon}{trangThai}, ma van don {maVanDon}. LINK TRA CUU DUNG (dan NGUYEN VAN, day la thu khach can): {link} — khach hoi hang di den dau / xin lai tracking thi gui DUNG link nay. TUYET DOI khong dua link san pham ({site}/product/...) hay link bo loc lam link tra cuu, va khong doc ma van don tran trui ma thieu link.
blocks.MAU_KHAC:
KHACH HOI MAU/BIEN THE KHAC cua {ten} ({ma}){bienTheHoi}. DANH SACH THAT (da loc, KHONG goi tra kho lai, KHONG them ma ngoai danh sach, KHONG noi "chi co mau nay"):
{danhSach}{linkLoc}
blocks.MAU_KHAC.doiTac: — hàng đối tác, đặt thêm ngày
blocks.MAU_KHAC.linkLoc: KET THUC bang dung 1 dong: "{Khach} xem đủ các mẫu còn hàng tại: {link}" (link NGUYEN VAN).
blocks.PHO_THONG: NHU CAU PHO THONG (khach KHONG nhac mon cu the): goi cong cu tra kho voi muc_dich="{mucDich}"{bienThe}{gioiTinh} (ten de rong). KHONG hoi cac cau tu van chuyen mon. Nhieu ma CUNG TEN (khac mau) la MOT mau: neu ten mot lan. Goi khach la "{khach}", KHONG goi "minh".{nhom}
blocks.PHO_THONG.nhom:
Tra loi THEO NHOM, moi nhom 1 dong "• " + 1-2 mau (ten + gia) + link nhom NGUYEN VAN o cuoi dong:
{nhom}
blocks.NHIEU_DONG:
KHUNG TU VAN NHIEU DONG + LINK (he thong da cham fit va loc kho): gioi thieu DU {so} HO ben duoi, moi ho 1 ly do ngan va dan NGUYEN VAN link cua ho. Khong rut con 1-2 mau le. Trong cung ho, vi du da xep doi moi -> campaign active -> gia tot; doi cu chi neu ro la doi truoc/gia thay the.
{danhSach}
blocks.MON: KHACH HOI THANG MON "{mon}" — shop CO ban mon nay ({so} mau con hang). Goi cong cu tra kho voi nhom="{mucDich}" (ten de rong){bienThe} roi tu van tren ket qua that. CAM tra loi "ben em khong ban / chua co dong nay".
blocks.LOAI_HANG: KHACH HOI LOAI HANG ({loai}) — shop CO ban tren web {site} du kho san khong con. Goi cong cu tra kho voi "ten" dung chu khach noi{bienThe} roi tu van tren ket qua that. Neu tra kho khong ra mau dung y khach thi KET bang dung 1 dong: "{Khach} xem các mẫu tại: {link}" (link NGUYEN VAN). CAM tra loi "ben em khong ban / chua co loai nay".
blocks.SIZE_TEM: BIEN THE CUA KHACH (tang 1 da tinh bang BANG CHUAN — nguon DUY NHAT, CAM tu tinh lai): {nhan}. Goi cong cu tra kho voi bien_the="{bienThe}".
blocks.SIZE_TEM.hang: Da quy theo bang rieng cua hang {hang}.
blocks.SIZE_TEM.chung: — QUY DOI CHUNG theo bang cua nganh (chua co bang rieng cua hang{hang} tren he thong): noi ro voi {khach} day chi la quy doi chung, KHONG khang dinh; moi {khach} xac nhan lai.
blocks.SO_DO.du: Tang 1 da tra BANG CHUAN (nguon DUY NHAT, CAM tu tinh lai): bien the {bienThe}{noi}.{rong}{doLai} Noi de mo ("voi so do nay em nghi ... se hop"), khong khang dinh chac.
blocks.SO_DO.thieu: CHUA DU SO DO (con thieu: {thieu}) → CHUA duoc neu bien the nao suy tu so do, CAM gan bien the vao link loc. Xin khach cho du {thieu}. Khach noi khong do duoc thi moi tu van theo so do da co. Khach hoi thang mot bien the cu the thi van bao con/het bien the do nhu binh thuong.
blocks.SO_DO.khongDo: Khach KHONG do duoc phan con lai → tam theo so do da co: bien the {bienThe}{noi} — noi ro la uoc chung, moi khach doi chieu voi bien the dang dung.{rong}{doLai}
blocks.SO_DO.ngoaiBang: So do VUOT BANG chuan → KHONG tu chot bien the; noi de em kiem tra them va bao nguoi phu trach.
blocks.SO_DO.chuaRo: CHUA RO khach can loai hang nao — moi loai quy doi khac nhau: hoi khach truoc khi neu bien the.
blocks.SO_DO.khongBang: Hang {hang} CHUA CO BANG quy doi tren he thong → KHONG doi so do ra nhan bien the{noi}; noi de em doi chieu va bao nguoi phu trach.
blocks.SO_DO.doLai: So do {doLai} lech xa bat thuong — nhac khach do lai cho chac, day la bien the TAM.
blocks.HO_SO_TU_VAN.dichDanh: KHACH HOI DICH DANH MAU (da goi ten / ma / anh / the cua mot mau cu the) → nhu cau DA RO: KHONG hoi khach mua de lam gi, KHONG hoi ho so tu van ({khongHoi}). Lam ngay: tra kho mau do → bao con/het bien the khach hoi (ten + gia + hang san/dat); them 1-2 cau mo ta mau lay tu du lieu he thong (khong bia); het thi goi y 2-3 mau cung loai dang con, moi mau 1 cau ly do. Khach chua noi bien the thi hoi bien the.
blocks.HO_SO_TU_VAN.du: HO SO TU VAN ({nhuCau}) DA DU — {daBiet}KHONG hoi them muc dich hay cac dieu tren; goi y ngay theo ho so nay. Bien the chi hoi khi khach chon mau / chot, khong chan viec goi y.
blocks.HO_SO_TU_VAN.thieu: HO SO TU VAN ({nhuCau}) — {daBiet}con thieu: {thieu} → hoi {thieu} trong MOT tin ngan, CHUA liet ke mau. KHONG hoi lai dieu da biet.
blocks.HO_SO_TU_VAN.daHoi: HO SO TU VAN ({nhuCau}) — {daBiet}page DA HOI {daHoi} trong phien nay ma khach chua tra loi ro → KHONG hoi lai lan nua (moi thong tin chi hoi mot lan). Goi y theo dieu da biet (chon mau de dung, an toan) va noi {khach} cho them thong tin neu muon chon sat hon.
blocks.HO_SO_TU_VAN.daHoiNhuCau: Page DA HOI khach mua de lam gi trong phien nay → KHONG hoi lai. Goi y vai mau dang con hang theo dieu khach da noi (bien the, gioi tinh, tam gia) hoac moi khach xem danh sach.
blocks.DON_DOI_SIZE: DON CUA KHACH{maDon} — DOI BIEN THE: {ketLuan}. {ghiChu}
blocks.DON_DANG_CHAY.dong: • Don {maDon} — {giaiDoan} — mon: {mon} — tong {tong}, da tra {daTra}, con lai {conLai}{vanDon}
blocks.DON_DANG_CHAY.vanDonDong: — VAN DON DA DONG (huy/hoan/giao that bai): KHONG gui link, KHONG noi dang giao, KHONG tu noi tinh trang giao; de nguoi phu trach bao
blocks.DON_DANG_CHAY.nhieuDon: Khach co {so} don dang chay: noi ro ma don khi tra loi, khong tron mon giua cac don.
blocks.DON_CU:
DON CU DA KET THUC (chi de biet khach da mua gi, KHONG khoa viec ban; khach mua lai thi ban binh thuong):
{danhSach}
